name: Harmony Touch 8.2, Test Cinema, an activity of ours
summary: An activity of ours: started from Off, its keys and screen entries, a switch to Watch TV and back, and Off.
description: todo-touch.md 8.2, on the bench Harmony Touch holding work/touch-firmware/sets/8.2-activity: the set of 8.1's put back with an activity of ours added, Test Cinema, composed from the bench devices by name (packages/corpus/touch-activities/test-cinema.json). Every expectation is derived from that set by packages/bench/src/touchengine.ts and named as the monitor names a code of the Touch's own documents. Step 1 presses Off and is not judged. In step 2, before tapping the activity, write in the problem field whether Test Cinema is on the activity list, last of 6 (Watch TV, Watch a Blu-ray, Listen to Music, Switch Box, Play a Game, Test Cinema), with its name and the picture of a custom activity; and once it has started, whether its command list shows 4 entries in this order, with no icons: Top Menu, Pop Up Menu, Subtitles, TV Info. Predicted for the start: the Blu-ray's PowerOn first, then the LG TV's, then the TV's input once its 10 second power on delay is out, then a pause of 3 s and the Blu-ray's TopMenu; no Denon code. Predicted per key: the volume keys to the LG TV, the rest to the Blu-ray; per screen entry, its command. Then Watch TV: the Blu-ray's Stop first, the Denon switched on, the Blu-ray switched off, the inputs. Then Test Cinema again: the Blu-ray switched on, the Denon left on, the TV's input, the pause and TopMenu. Off: the Blu-ray's Stop, the LG TV and the Blu-ray switched off in that order, then the Denon. Wait for the codes to stop before pressing Next: a start runs about 15 seconds, most of it the LG TV's power on delay.

steps.instruction: Button: Up → Button: Down → Button: Left → Button: Right → Button: OK
Button: Volume Up → Button: Volume Down → Button: Mute
Button: Play → Button: Pause → Button: Stop
Screen: Top Menu → Screen: Pop Up Menu → Screen: Subtitles → Screen: TV Info
